passages.text: “For behold, the day is coming, burning like a furnace, when all the arrogant and every evildoer will be stubble; the day is coming when I will set them ablaze,” says the LORD of Hosts. “Not a root or branch will be left to them.”
passages.sermon:
The LORD of Hosts speaks.
He is the God who commands armies.
He says a day is coming.
This day will burn like a furnace.
On that day, all arrogant people will become like stubble.
Every person who does evil will also become like stubble.
The LORD of Hosts will set them ablaze on that day.
He will not leave them any root.
He will not leave them any branch.
passages.original: כִּֽי־ הִנֵּ֤ה הַיּוֹם֙ בָּ֔א בֹּעֵ֖ר כַּתַּנּ֑וּר וְהָי֨וּ כָל־ זֵדִ֜ים וְכָל־ עֹשֵׂ֤ה רִשְׁעָה֙ קַ֔שׁ וְלִהַ֨ט אֹתָ֜ם הַיּ֣וֹם הַבָּ֗א אָמַר֙ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת אֲשֶׁ֛ר לֹא־ יַעֲזֹ֥ב לָהֶ֖ם שֹׁ֥רֶשׁ וְעָנָֽף׃

passages.text: “But for you who fear My name, the sun of righteousness will rise with healing in its wings, and you will go out and leap like calves from the stall.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to those who fear His name.
You honor and respect God.
For you, the sun of righteousness will rise.
This sun brings healing in its wings.
You will go out.
You will leap with joy.
You will be like calves released from the stall.
passages.original: וְזָרְחָ֨ה לָכֶ֜ם יִרְאֵ֤י שְׁמִי֙ שֶׁ֣מֶשׁ צְדָקָ֔ה וּמַרְפֵּ֖א בִּכְנָפֶ֑יהָ וִֽיצָאתֶ֥ם וּפִשְׁתֶּ֖ם כְּעֶגְלֵ֥י מַרְבֵּֽק׃

passages.text: Then you will trample the wicked, for they will be ashes under the soles of your feet on the day I am preparing,” says the LORD of Hosts.
passages.sermon:
The LORD of Hosts speaks.
He is preparing a special day.
On that day, you will trample the wicked.
The wicked will become ashes.
Their ashes will be under the soles of your feet.
passages.original: וְעַסּוֹתֶ֣ם רְשָׁעִ֔ים כִּֽי־ יִהְי֣וּ אֵ֔פֶר תַּ֖חַת כַּפּ֣וֹת רַגְלֵיכֶ֑ם בַּיּוֹם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אֲנִ֣י עֹשֶׂ֔ה אָמַ֖ר יְהוָ֥ה צְבָאֽוֹת׃פ

passages.text: “Remember the law of My servant Moses, the statutes and ordinances I commanded him for all Israel at Horeb.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to the people of Israel.
God calls Moses His servant.
God gave Moses the law at Horeb.
God commanded Moses to teach all Israel.
The law includes statutes.
The law includes ordinances.
God tells the people to remember this law.
passages.original: זִכְר֕וּ תּוֹרַ֖ת מֹשֶׁ֣ה עַבְדִּ֑י אֲשֶׁר֩ צִוִּ֨יתִי אוֹת֤וֹ בְחֹרֵב֙ עַל־ כָּל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל חֻקִּ֖ים וּמִשְׁפָּטִֽים׃

passages.text: Behold, I will send you Elijah the prophet before the coming of the great and awesome Day of the LORD.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to His people.
God promises to act.
God will send Elijah.
Elijah is a prophet.
God will send Elijah to you.
God will do this before the Day of the LORD comes.
The Day of the LORD will be great.
The Day of the LORD will be awesome.
passages.original: הִנֵּ֤ה אָֽנֹכִי֙ שֹׁלֵ֣חַ לָכֶ֔ם אֵ֖ת אֵלִיָּ֣ה הַנָּבִ֑יא לִפְנֵ֗י בּ֚וֹא י֣וֹם יְהוָ֔ה הַגָּד֖וֹל וְהַנּוֹרָֽא׃

passages.text: And he will turn the hearts of the fathers to their children, and the hearts of the children to their fathers. Otherwise, I will come and strike the land with a curse.”
passages.sermon:
God will send Elijah the prophet.
Elijah will turn the hearts of fathers to their children.
Elijah will turn the hearts of children to their fathers.
If this does not happen, I will come.
I will strike the land with a curse.
passages.original: וְהֵשִׁ֤יב לֵב־ אָבוֹת֙ עַל־ בָּנִ֔ים וְלֵ֥ב בָּנִ֖ים עַל־ אֲבוֹתָ֑ם פֶּן־ אָב֕וֹא וְהִכֵּיתִ֥י אֶת־ הָאָ֖רֶץ חֵֽרֶם׃
